instruction.text: Which stylistic device is used in the sentence?

atoms.a: Some students just sit silently in their chairs.
Fierce flames flickered in the fireplace.
The light of the fire brightened the night sky.
Mike likes to ride his bike on Friday nights.

The crime scene revealed chaos as broken glass covered the floor, overturned drawers spilled their contents everywhere, pictures hung crooked or lay shattered on the ground, and a terrible silence hung over the devastated room.

The festival was an overwhelming sensory experience. Music blared from multiple stages simultaneously, the smell of food from dozens of vendors filled the air, crowds pressed in from all directions, bright lights flashed and swirled overhead.
The marriage counsellor files for divorce after only six months of marriage.
The anti-technology activist posted his manifesto on social media instead of sending it by post.
The mathematics teacher called in sick because she had too many problems to deal with.
The graveyard is so crowded, people are dying to get in.
The angry waves crashed against the shore, demanding to be heard.
The wind whispered secrets through the old oak trees, carrying messages only the forest understood.
Her eyes were windows into her soul, revealing every emotion she tried to hide.
The room was a prison of fluorescent lights and rigid desks.
Her smile was as bright as the morning sun breaking through the clouds.
The old man's hands were like weathered maps.
